title: Scientists cored Clear Lake, finding ancient pollen records in sediment that reveal how California forests changed with past climate shifts
description: The sediment cores from Clear Lake present a captivating window into California's forest history over the last half-million years. Research conducted by the USGS and UC Berkeley unveils an unbroken record of climate and vegetation changes, beginning with initial studies in 1973 that traced back 130,000 years. This ongoing research is instrumental in enhancing our predictions regarding future climate change impacts.

title: Nepal Flash Flood Decimates Holy Town of Devi Ghat, Killing Scores and Destroying Ancient Kali Temple
description: A devastating flash flood has destroyed the northern Nepalese town of Devi Ghat on the banks of the River Trishuli, washing away its ancient Kali temple and killing at least one hundred of its one thousand residents. Survivors now shelter in a hillside school camp receiving only one meal a day as they attempt to salvage belongings from the mud and debris.
